name: Mr Price Group Limited
summary: Mr Price Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides fashion-value merchandise in South Africa and internationally. It operates through five segments: Apparel, Homeware, Financial Services, Telecoms, and Central Services. The company offers clothing, sportswear, accessories, babywear, football supporters' gear, casual wear, schoolwear, underwear, footwear, sporting equipment, and cosmetics; home textiles, décor products, accessories, kitchen and dining products, furniture, and kids merchandise; and mobile devices and accessories, as well as value added services, such as airtime, data, electricity, and DStv and bus ticketing.
